name: Minerals 260 Limited
summary: Minerals 260 Limited engages in the exploration and evaluation of mineral resources in Australia. The company explores for gold, palladium, nickel, and copper, as well as precious metals. The company holds 100% interest in the Bullabulling Gold Project located in south-west of Kalgoorlie, Western Australian in the Eastern Goldfields; and the Moora project covering an area of 371 square kilometers located in Julimar Mineral Province, Western Australia. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is based in West Perth, Australia.
